items.name: Shahi Angara Paneer Tikka
items.description: Charcoal grilled cottage cheese marinated in hung curd, Kashmiri deghi mirch, and hand-ground royal garam masala. Served with smoky mint glaze.

items.name: Crispy Golden Spring Rolls
items.description: Crispy golden wrappers filled with julienned Asian wok vegetables, scallions, and water chestnuts. Served with sweet spicy chilli reduction.

items.name: Heritage Dal Bukhara / Makhani
items.description: Slow simmered overnight on charcoal hearths with whole urad lentils, slow-churned white butter, vine-ripened tomatoes, and fresh malai.

items.name: Nawabi Dum Veg Biryani
items.description: Aged royal basmati rice layered with saffron milk, marinated seasonal garden vegetables, fried cashews, caramelized birista, and mint leaves.

items.name: Purani Dilli Shahi Chaat Station
items.description: Live counter featuring organic Dahi Bhalla, crispy Palak Patta Chaat, Matra Kulcha, and artisanal Golgappe with 5 flavored herbal waters.

items.name: Desi Ghee Jalebi with Laccha Rabri
items.nameHindi: शुद्ध देसी घी जलेबी लच्छा रबड़ी
items.description: Piping hot spiral jalebis fried live in pure cow desi ghee, infused with saffron syrup, served alongside chilled hand-stirred earthen pot rabri.

items.name: Royal Chandi Varq Mithai Thal
items.description: Heritage platter boasting pure Kaju Katli with real silver foil, Saffron Rasmalai, Pista Mawa Barfi, and Ghee Motichoor Ladoos.

items.name: Maharaja Grand Royal Feast Thali
items.description: Comprehensive royal dining experience with 12 handcrafted katoris: Shahi Paneer, Pindi Chole, Dal Makhani, Boondi Raita, Pulao, assorted breads, and sweets.

items.name: Amritsari Live Tandoor & Rotis
items.description: Live clay ovens churning out hot Butter Naans, Missi Rotis, Chur-Chur Naan, and Laccha Parathas brushed with clarified butter.

items.name: Rajwadi Kesaria Thandai & Sharbats
items.description: Stone-ground almond and pistachio milk scented with Kashmiri saffron, rose petal water, and organic herbal coolers.
